lines: There with full form I describe Khecarī alone; having bound lotus-seat, yogī should cast navel-ākāśa-īśvara.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra pūrṇena rūpeṇa khecarīmeva varṇaye baddhvā padmāsanaṃ yogī nābhāvakṣeśvaraṃ kṣipet
